external_source_policy: No new compatible source supplied/available locally; do not download unknown rulesets
fold_algorithm: sha256('phase2.2-dev-fold-v1:' + group_representative), first8 unsigned big-endian modulo5; representative=min match ID of identical whole observable trajectory, otherwise self; validation=bucket fold_id

previous_evaluation_cohorts.kind: Phase2.1 original validation /all learning-curve and selected-model development

fair_reference_rule: Retrain E0 from random initialization under exactly the candidate train/development restrictions; never use saved v2 in-sample scores as held-out reference
